sentences.text: CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE RAJESH KUMAR ---------

For the Petitioner : Mr. Altamash Khan, Advocate For the State : Mrs. Snehlika Bhagat, A.P.P ---------
 th 04/Dated: 15 May, 2024 1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned counsel for the State.
2. The applicant, who is in custody since 06.09.2023, has renewed the prayer for grant of regular bail in connection with Bhandra P.S Case No.35 of 2023.
3. It appears that this applicant has been made an accused for committing the offence under Sections 313/ 307/ 323/ 376/ 420 of I.P.C.

Earlier, the prayer for bail of this applicant was rejected vide order dated 24.01.2024, passed in B.A.
No.11330 of 2023.
4.

It has been submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant that complete set of F.I.R along with its enclosures have been annexed with the present bail application and there is no suppression on his part.
Innocence of the applicant has been claimed and undertaking has been given for participation in the trial.
It has been submitted that the charge has already been framed.
On the above basis, prayer for bail has been renewed.
Vardan Oraon vs The State Of Jharkhand .....

5. Learned A.P.P has opposed the prayer for bail.
6. Considering the fact that charge has already been framed and both the parties are major, I am inclined to enlarge the applicant on bail.

Accordingly, the applicant is directed to be released on bail,
on his furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Lohardaga in connection with Bhandra P.S Case No.35 of 2023 on the condition that the applicant will submit self-attested photocopy of his Aadhaar Card and his mobile number before the learned court below which he will always keep active and will not change it during pendency of this case without prior permission of the court.
(Rajesh Kumar, J.) Chandan/-
